open_points.subject: A17 credential secret-file path resolution
open_points.text: “the absolute path of a secret file, or the kernel refuses to start” contradicts “Here and in rule 2 … a relative one from the working directory”
open_points.question: Does rule 2 permit a relative credential secret-file path, or does the absolute-path requirement still apply and the relative-path walk apply only to the configuration-file argument?
options: Credential secret-file paths must remain absolute; only the configuration-file argument may be relative.
Both configuration and credential secret-file paths may be absolute or relative.
open_points.default_guess: Keep credential secret-file paths absolute and apply the relative-path rule only to the configuration-file argument.
